parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ systemInstruction: { parts: [{ text: 'You are an invoice data extraction assistant. Extract data from the invoice and return ONLY a valid JSON object (no markdown, no code fences) with these fields: vendor (string, seller company name), billTo (string, customer company name), invoiceNumber (string), invoiceDate (string YYYY-MM-DD or null), dueDate (string YYYY-MM-DD or null), poNumber (string or null, purchase order number), paymentTerms (string or null, e.g. Net 30), currency (string ISO code e.g. USD), subtotal (number or null), taxRate (number or null, tax percentage e.g. 8.5), taxAmount (number or 0), totalAmount (number), lineItems (array of objects with description, quantity, unitPrice, amount). Use null for missing fields. Verify: subtotal = sum of line item amounts, taxAmount = subtotal * taxRate / 100, totalAmount = subtotal + taxAmount.' }] }, contents: [{ parts: [{ text: ($json.body && $json.body.invoiceText) || $json.invoiceText || '' }] }], generationConfig: { responseMimeType: 'application/json', temperature: 0 } }) }}

parameters.text: ={{ 'New invoice from *' + $json.vendor + '* | Bill to: ' + $json.billTo + ' | Amount: ' + $json.currency + ' ' + $json.totalAmount + ' | Invoice #' + $json.invoiceNumber + ' | Math: ' + $json.mathCheck + ' | Status: ' + $json.status }}

={{ 'APPROVAL NEEDED: Invoice ' + $json.invoiceNumber + ' from ' + $json.vendor + ' | Bill to: ' + $json.billTo + ' | Amount: ' + $json.currency + ' ' + $json.totalAmount + ' | Math check: ' + $json.mathCheck + ' (over threshold).

POST JSON to: ' + $execution.resumeUrl + '

Body: {"dedupKey": "' + $json.dedupKey + '", "status": "Approved"} (or "Rejected")

Please also include "approvedBy": "<your name or email>" for the audit trail.' }}
